Point Description
Earn 11 points for each B prize drawn from this box. 
   
Gameplay Rules
The prize pool has a total probability of 100%, and each draw guarantees a prize. All results are randomly generated by the system (refer to the prize probability list for details), not influenced by time or users. Every participant has an equal chance.
All draw chances are generated fairly and randomly and no manual interference required.
 
Mode Description
1. Multiplayer Mode: Participate in the same prize pool together with other users. All users share the pool, creating a more lively atmosphere.
2.Solo Mode: The user draws independently. The prize pool is separate and only valid for the individual, unaffected by other users.
 
Shipping Instructions
All prizes are 100% authentic, sourced from official brands or authorized dealers. Prizes will be shipped within 1–15 working days (refer to User’s location and stock availability). You can track the shipping status in ‘Orders’ section on the platform.
 
Important Notes
1.  Minor scratches, paint flaws, or color differences that meet manufacturer standards are considered normal and not eligible for return/exchange.
2.  Minor damage to packaging due to logistics (e.g. dents or tape issues) is not eligible for return/exchange.
3.  Users under 18 years old are not permitted to make purchases.
  
*Apple is not a sponsor of this event, nor is it involved in any way.
